steps.text: Jansen Stead, just inside Westfall. Take Poor Old Blanchy and Verna's Westfall Stew delivery for Salma.
Loot every Sack of Oats you pass from here on (Poor Old Blanchy).
Hand Verna's Westfall Stew delivery to Salma.
Then take her cooking quests.
Sentinel Hill: get the flight path from Thor and set your Hearthstone.
Top of Sentinel Tower.
Kill Harvest Watchers around Saldean's Farm and loot oats around the farms. Keep Okra drops.
steps.warn: Harvest Watchers stand close together in the fields.
steps.tip: Pull from the field edges; they're slow, so you can back away to fight one at a time.

steps.text: Goretusks (livers, snouts), vultures (stringy meat) and coast murlocs (eyes) around northern Westfall.
Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm: the pocket watch is in the wardrobe inside the farmhouse.
Kill Defias Trappers and Smugglers around Jangolode Mine and the northern farms.
steps.warn: Defias stand in tight groups near Jangolode Mine.
steps.tip: Pull from the edges of each camp. Smugglers can stun; keep your health high before the next pull.

steps.text: Already 14? Take The Defias Brotherhood too (it needs level 14); you'll hand it in at Lakeshire in Redridge.
Kill Riverpaw gnolls west of the road for 8 Gnoll Paws.
steps.warn: Riverpaw gnolls are often in pairs, and Riverpaw Mystics heal.
steps.tip: Kill the Mystic first.

steps.text: Defias Pillagers and Looters at the Gold Coast Quarry, Moonbrook and Alexston Farmstead.
steps.warn: Pillagers cast fireballs and Moonbrook is crowded.
steps.tip: Do the quarry and Alexston first; only pull Moonbrook's outer houses.

steps.text: Grind gnolls/Defias to 14 if needed.
Now you're 14: take The Defias Brotherhood from Gryan (you'll hand it in at Lakeshire), then fly to Stormwind.
Then take the Deeprun Tram to Ironforge and run east to Loch Modan.

quests.224.0: In Defense of the King's Lands

steps.text: Southern Guard Tower, where the road from Dun Morogh enters Loch Modan.
Stonesplinter Valley (entrance near 27, 65): kill troggs and scouts, loot Trogg Stone Teeth.
steps.warn: Stonesplinter troggs stand very close together.
steps.tip: Fight on the edges of the valley and use line of sight to pull single troggs.

steps.text: Take the next In Defense of the King's Lands steps from the tower if you want more trogg XP.
Run north to Thelsamar. Get the flight path and set your Hearthstone.
Algaz Station, the tower at the north end of the road.
Silver Stream Mine: Tunnel Rat ears from the kobolds, Miners' Gear from the crates inside.
steps.warn: The kobold tunnels are crowded and respawn quickly.
steps.tip: Grab crates along the walls and do not chase runners deeper into the mine.

steps.text: Bear meat, boar intestines and spider ichor from the wildlife west of the road.
Farstrider Lodge on the east shore.
Loch crocolisks on the shores and southern island.
Grind to 16 if needed. Optional extra quests here: Ironband's Excavation, A Dark Threat Looms (dam), WANTED: Chok'sul.
Fly to Ironforge, train, tram to Stormwind and run east through Elwynn to Redridge.
Three Corners, at the Elwynn border.
Get the Lakeshire flight path.
Set your Hearthstone at the Lakeshire inn.
Upstairs in the inn.
New in WoW Forever.
You'll deliver these shoes in Goldshire on your trainer trip; that unlocks Verner's best quests.
Search the Glinting Mud on the lake bottom west of the bridge.
Dive for the sunken chest by the rowboat.
steps.warn: The Lake Thresher patrols underwater near the chest.
steps.tip: Wait for it to swim away and watch your breath bar.

steps.text: South of Lakeshire: gnoll Mongrels/Poachers, tarantulas, Great Goretusks and Dire Condors.
WoW Forever quest: Greater Tarantulas and Tarantula Eggs at Alther's Mill. Skip if you didn't get it.
Murlocs east of Lakeshire for Spotted Sunfish (keep any Murloc Fins).
steps.tip: Pull murlocs one at a time to the shore; they flee and bring friends.

steps.text: Gnolls north-west of Lakeshire: Iron Pikes and Rivets.
steps.warn: Redridge Brutes and Mystics come in packs of 2-3.
steps.tip: Pull around tents with ranged/line of sight. Kill Mystics first.

steps.text: Grind gnolls to 19 if needed.
Fly to Stormwind and train. Then run out the gate to Goldshire for the shoes delivery.
Goldshire smithy (Elwynn Forest).
Then run east back to Lakeshire (or fly from Stormwind).
Murloc Poachers needs level 20; skip if you're lower.
Redridge Brutes around 24, 35 and Mystics around 28, 29.
Black Dragon Whelps south of the lake for Underbelly Whelp Scales.
steps.warn: Whelps cast fireballs from range.
steps.tip: Close the gap fast or use line of sight; don't trade spells with them at range.

steps.text: Murloc Fins from the murlocs east of Lakeshire.
Kill Yowler in the northernmost gnoll camp.
steps.warn: Yowler is several levels higher than you.
steps.tip: Be level 19-20, clear the gnolls nearby first, and use every cooldown or bring a friend.

steps.text: Optional: Stonewatch Keep and Tower of Ilgalar elite quests (Wanted: Gath'Ilzogg, Solomon's Law). Skip these solo.
steps.tip: Pull outside the keep walls, crowd-control the casters, and let the tank hold the elite.

steps.text: Grind Blackrock orcs / whelps to 19 if needed. Then fly Lakeshire -> Stormwind -> Sentinel Hill.
Final part of The People's Militia. Also take any Defias Brotherhood follow-ups from Gryan.
Defias Highwaymen, Pathstalkers and Knuckledusters in the Dagger Hills and around Moonbrook, south Westfall.
steps.warn: Defias here are level 17-19 and pull in groups near Moonbrook.
steps.tip: Work the Dagger Hills camps from the outside in and avoid the Moonbrook town square.

steps.text: Optional: The Deadmines (entrance in Moonbrook) with The Defias Brotherhood, Red Silk Bandanas and Oh Brother... quests. Dungeon quest XP is higher in WoW Forever.
Grind Defias / coastal murlocs to 20 if needed.
Fly to Stormwind and train, then fly to Darkshire (or run south through Elwynn).
Darkshire: get the flight path and set your Hearthstone at the inn.
Hand this in right away in Darkshire.
Hand this in right away in Darkshire.
Skeletal Fiends and Horrors at the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery south-east of Darkshire.
steps.warn: Skeletons stand close together around the graves.
steps.tip: Pull from the cemetery edge and never fight in the middle.

steps.text: Dire wolves along the northern riverbank for Lean Wolf Flanks. Kill spiders you meet for the totem quest.
Jitters hides by the well at Raven Hill.
Abercrombie's shack is north-east of Raven Hill Cemetery.
steps.warn: Mor'Ladim (elite) patrols the cemetery path.
steps.tip: Watch for his patrol and go around him.

steps.text: Sven's camp at the Hushed Bank, far west.
Spiders and wolves around northern Duskwood for the totem items.
Back in Darkshire: hand these in and take the follow-ups (Dusky Crab Cakes, Ghost Hair Thread).
Crabs along the northern river.
Talk to Madame Eva, then take the thread to Abercrombie.
Jitters at the Raven Hill well, then Abercrombie's shack.
Grind wolves, spiders or skeletons to 24 if needed.
Fly to Stormwind and train. Then tram to Ironforge, fly to Thelsamar and run north through Dun Algaz into the Wetlands (or fly to Menethil if you have it).
Thelsamar: Report to Mountaineer Rockgar (it opens the Menethil quests).
At the Dun Algaz gate, north Loch Modan.
The Algaz Gauntlet: just make it through Dun Algaz to Menethil Harbor.
Menethil Harbor: get the flight path and set your Hearthstone.
steps.warn: The road from Dun Algaz to Menethil passes Dragonmaw orcs and raptors.
steps.tip: Stay on the road and mount up/run past; don't fight on the way.

steps.text: Right next to Valstag in Menethil Keep.
WoW Forever: Caitlin Grassman (house at 11.9, 58.8) starts the Excavation Site dungeon quests; take them if you'll run it.
Kill 12 Bluegill Murlocs on the coast north of Menethil.
steps.warn: Bluegill murlocs come in groups and flee to bring friends.
steps.tip: Pull from the edge of each camp.

steps.text: Offered once Claws from the Deep is handed in.
Damaged Crate at the Bluegill murloc camp north of Menethil.
steps.warn: Bluegill murlocs come in groups and flee to bring friends.
steps.tip: Pull from the edge and click the crates once the area's clear.

steps.text: Sealed Barrel in the hovels just north.
Half-buried Barrel a little further north.
Back in Menethil Harbor.
Young crocolisks around Menethil.
Hand in at Menethil Harbor.
Raptors in the hills west of the excavation. Pick up excavation fragments as you go.
steps.warn: Mottled raptors fight in pairs and hit hard.
steps.tip: Pull with range and fight away from the next pack.

steps.text: Mosshide gnolls south-east and west of Rethiel.
Fire Taboo is only offered once Tramping Paws is handed in.
Back to the Mosshide gnolls: Crude Flints only drop now that you have the quest.
(Blisters on The Land comes next, but its Fen Creepers are in the far west and it hands in back here - skip it.)
Angerfang Encampment, on the way back west.
steps.warn: Dragonmaw orcs in the camp are in groups of 2-3.
steps.tip: Clear the outer tents first and pull to the hillside.

steps.text: Optional (WoW Forever): Excavation Site: Wetlands dungeon (levels 26-33) with its quests.
Grind crocolisks or raptors to 27 if needed.
Fly to Stormwind, train, then fly to Darkshire.
Dig at the Mound of Loose Dirt at the Yorgen Farmstead.
Raven Hill Cemetery: Skeletal Fiends/Horrors and Skeleton Fingers; Rot Blossoms on the ground.
steps.warn: The cemetery is crowded and Mor'Ladim (elite) patrols it.
steps.tip: Work the edges and keep an eye out for his patrol.

steps.text: Darkshire.
Darkshire: ask around town (the large house, town hall and the inn).
Nightbane Shadow Weavers in Brightwood Grove, west of Darkshire.
steps.warn: Nightbane worgen hit hard and Shadow Weavers cast shadow bolts.
steps.tip: Fight one at a time on open ground.

steps.text: North-west mausoleum: Skeletal Raiders, Healers and Warders.
steps.warn: Skeletal Healers heal everything near them.
steps.tip: Kill Healers first and pull Warders away from the group.

steps.text: North-east mausoleum: Plague Spreaders for Ghoul Ribs and Fangs.
A Weathered Grave, north of the cemetery.
Starts the Morbent Fel chain in Stormwind; finish it later at 30+.
Vul'Gol Ogre Mound.
steps.warn: Ogres come in pairs and hit very hard.
steps.tip: Pull singles from the mound's edge.

steps.text: Darkshire.
Grind worgen, skeletons or ogres to 30 if needed.
Fly to Stormwind and train level 30 skills, then head south to Stranglethorn Vale.
Seeking Wisdom: Bishop Farthing in the Cathedral of Light, while you're in Stormwind.
From Auberdine, get the flight path and run south through Darkshore into Ashenvale.

Get the Astranaar flight path, set your Hearthstone, and accept all quests in town (Raene's Cleansing chain, The Ruins of Stardust, An Aggressive Defense, Culling the Threat, A Helping Hand, Fallen Sky Lake).
Do the Thistlefur furbolg, Ruins of Stardust and Lake Iris quests around Astranaar.
steps.warn: Thistlefur Hold is a dense cave; on PvP realms Horde often quest here too.
steps.tip: Do Thistlefur outside first; inside, pull one at a time from the ramps.

steps.text: Visit Maestra's Post and the Zoram Strand to the west for more quests.
Finish the Ashenvale quests and turn in at Astranaar.
Fly to Auberdine -> boat to Menethil -> fly to Stormwind and train (night elves can train in Darnassus instead).
From Darkshire, take the road south out of Duskwood into Stranglethorn. Get the Rebel Camp flight path.
steps.warn: Stranglethorn is a PvP hotspot on PvP realms.
steps.tip: Quest near the camps when you can and watch for Horde around Nesingwary's.

steps.text: Rebel Camp.
Nesingwary's Expedition, south of the Rebel Camp across the river.
Young Stranglethorn Tigers south-west of camp; Young Panthers along the road and river.
steps.warn: Young panthers are stealthed.
steps.tip: Walk slowly and pull panthers as soon as you spot the shimmer.

steps.text: Stranglethorn Tigers on the hill to the west; Panthers across the river.
Kurzen's soldiers around the compound east of the Rebel Camp; medicine drops from Kurzen medicine men.
steps.warn: Kurzen camps are packed with casters and medicine men who heal.
steps.tip: Kill healers first and stay outside the compound walls and cave.

steps.text: Stranglethorn Raptors on the hill south-west of Nesingwary's.
steps.warn: Raptors run in packs.
steps.tip: Pull from the edge and kill one before the next arrives.

steps.text: Run south to Booty Bay: get the flight path and set your Hearthstone at the Salty Sailor Tavern.
Krazek is upstairs in the Booty Bay tavern.
Grind tigers/raptors near Nesingwary's to 34 if needed.
Fly to Stormwind and train, then tram to Ironforge and fly to Menethil. Run north over Thandol Span into Arathi.
Before you leave Stormwind: Malin's Request from Archmage Malin in the Mage Quarter (opens Refuge Pointe's quests).
And Morgan Stern from Angus Stern at the Blue Recluse (you'll hand it in at Theramore for Mudrock Soup and Bugs).
Cross Thandol Span and follow the road to Refuge Pointe. Get the flight path.
steps.warn: Dark Iron dwarves guard the bridge and the road.
steps.tip: Ride through; don't stop to fight on the span.

steps.text: Northfold Manor.
Hand Malin's Request to Skuerto.
Worth Its Weight in Gold.
Syndicate Highwaymen and Mercenaries at Northfold Manor, north-west of Refuge Pointe.
steps.warn: Syndicate stand very close together and rogues stealth around the manor.
steps.tip: Use ranged pulls, pull to doorways and watch your back for stealthers.

steps.text: Stromgarde Badges (offered once Northfold Manor is done).
Badges drop from the Syndicate around Northfold and outside Stromgarde.
Witherbark trolls in the south-east: tusks, medicine pouches and a Shadow Hunter Knife.
steps.warn: Witherbark trolls fight in groups and their shadow hunters hit hard.
steps.tip: Clear the outer huts first.

steps.text: Optional: Stromgarde Keep quests (elite ogres and Syndicate inside the keep).
steps.tip: Bring a group or skip the keep.

steps.text: Grind to 36 if needed.
Fly to Ironforge and train, then fly to Menethil and take the boat to Theramore.
Theramore: get the flight path at the gates and set your Hearthstone at the inn.
steps.warn: Dustwallow mobs don't scale; arriving too early means a lot of deaths.
steps.tip: Be 36+ before leaving the island.

steps.text: Angus's letter to Morgan Stern.
Mudrock Soup and Bugs (skipped if you didn't bring Angus's letter).
Top floor of Foothold Citadel.
Mudrock tortoises along the coast for Forked Mudrock Tongues.
Swamplight Manor, north of the road. Soothing Spices: buy 3 from a trade goods vendor (Theramore has one) and hand them straight back.
steps.tip: Buy the spices in Theramore before you ride out.

steps.text: Jarl Needs Eyes (skipped if you didn't do Soothing Spices).
A Spy's Report can be found in the manor.
From the Black Shield over the manor's fireplace.
Darkmist spiders for Unpopped Darkmist Eyes.
steps.warn: Darkmist widows web you and come in groups.
steps.tip: Clear from the outside in and keep a potion ready.

steps.text: Stinky's Escape: escort him out of the north marsh (you hand it in to Morgan Stern in Theramore).
steps.warn: Escorts pull extra mobs along the way.
steps.tip: Clear the path ahead of him and stay close.

steps.text: Hungry!: a friendly ogre in northern Dustwallow.
Mirefin murlocs for 8 Mirefin Heads.
Shady Rest Inn, the burned inn on the western road.
Hearth to Theramore.
... and Bugs (level 40): Pristine Crawler Legs from the coast crawlers; do it now if you're close to 38.
Mirefin and Saltspittle crawlers along the Theramore coast; follow the arrow.
Any Theramore Lieutenant.
Foothold Citadel, upstairs. Take any follow-ups.
Grind to 38 if needed.
Train in Theramore if your class has a trainer there, otherwise boat to Menethil and fly to Stormwind.
steps.tip: Start saving gold now - your mount at 40 costs about 90-100g in Classic. Skip auction-house upgrades.

steps.text: Fly to Booty Bay (boat Theramore -> Menethil, fly to Stormwind, then Booty Bay).
Fly to the Rebel Camp and walk to Nesingwary's.
Bloodscalp trolls at Bal'lal Ruins, then Tkashi Ruins.
steps.warn: Bloodscalp trolls come in groups of 2-3.
steps.tip: Fight at the edge of the ruins and save escapes for runners.

steps.text: Elder Stranglethorn Tigers south of Tkashi Ruins; Lashtail Raptors to the south-east.
Shadowmaw Panthers in the jungle further south.
steps.warn: Shadowmaw panthers are stealthed and hit very hard.
steps.tip: Move slowly and pull them before they open on you.

steps.text: Venture Co. around Lake Nazferiti and the oil rig; crocolisks along the river.
At 40, fly to Stormwind, train and buy your mount if you can afford it.
Booty Bay. Take the follow-ups (Venture Company Mining, Some Assembly Required).
Water Elementals: the island off the south-west coast.
Optional: Mosh'Ogg ogre quests (elite) and Zul'Gurub-adjacent troll quests need a group.
steps.warn: The Gurubashi Arena is a free-for-all PvP area.
steps.tip: Stay away from the Arena when the chest event runs.

steps.text: Grind to 41 if needed, then fly Booty Bay -> Darkshire for the Swamp of Sorrows.
Step off the Riverglades boat at Steamwheedle Port and ride west to Gadgetzan. (From Shen'dralas or Kalimdor: fly to Theramore and ride south.)
Gadgetzan: get the flight path and set your Hearthstone at the inn.
Thistleshrub Valley needs level 45; take it if you already are.
Wanted poster next to the Gadgetzan bank.
Noonshade Ruins east of town: Wastewander Bandits and Thieves. Pouches drop from any Wastewander.
steps.warn: Wastewander Shadow Mages are stealthy-casters and Thieves come in pairs.
steps.tip: Pull from the outer dunes and kill casters first. Tag everything - pouches drop from all nomads.

steps.text: Run east to Steamwheedle Port.
Yeh'kinya - keep this one; the screechers are in Feralas.
Back to Gadgetzan.
Use the Untapped Dowsing Widget at the Noxious Lair oasis west of town.
steps.warn: Centipaar silithid swarm the oasis once you use the widget.
steps.tip: Clear the pool edge first, then use the widget and fight with your back to the wall.

steps.text: Waterspring Field / Wastewander camps south-east: Rogues, Assassins, Shadow Mages. Caliph patrols here.
steps.warn: Caliph Scorpidsting walks with two stealthed assassins.
steps.tip: Use a detect-stealth effect or fight near a wall; burst Caliph once the assassins are down.

steps.text: Lost Rigger Cove: Southsea pirates, hats, and Stoley's stolen wine (second floor of the two-storey house at 72,46). Andre Firebeard is in the big house.
steps.warn: [Elite-like density] Pirates are packed and the cove patrols; Andre Firebeard has adds.
steps.tip: Pull from the ridge downward, wait out patrols, and save a cooldown for Andre.

steps.text: Kill Centipaar Swarmers in the Noxious Lair for Centipaar Insect Parts.
steps.warn: Silithid tunnels chain-pull easily.
steps.tip: Stay near the entrance and pull single bugs.

steps.text: Thistleshrub Valley in the south-west: Gnarled Thistleshrubs and Thistleshrub Rootshapers.
Grind Wastewander nomads until level 45 - you keep earning Steamwheedle reputation too.
Run north from Gadgetzan through Thousand Needles, west along the Feralas road to the coast dock (no Alliance flight path to Feathermoon yet).
steps.warn: The Thousand Needles - Feralas road passes Grimtotem and Horde-friendly areas.
steps.tip: Mount up and don't stop until you reach the coast.

steps.text: Take the boat to Feathermoon Stronghold. Flight path and Hearthstone here.
Take the boat back to the mainland and head to the Dream Bough / Lower Wilds region.
Zorbin Fandazzle on the dock - giant-zapping quests.
Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker on Wave Striders and Land Walkers (giants) roaming the middle of Feralas.
steps.warn: The giants hit very hard and stun.
steps.tip: Shrink them first, then kill; don't fight one at full size.

steps.text: Kill Sea Elementals / Water Elementals along the coast for Fuel.
Yeti hides (Feral Scar Vale / Ridge yetis) and Frayfeather hippogryph feathers for Pratt.
Feral Scar Vale: kill Vale Screechers and use Yeh'kinya's Bramble on their corpses. Hand it in at Steamwheedle Port on the way to Un'Goro.
Zukk'ash Hive in the far north: collect the Hive samples.
steps.warn: The Zukk'ash Hive is dense and Zukk'ash Wasps add constantly.
steps.tip: Work the outer ring; pull with a ranged attack and leave before respawns catch up.

steps.text: Return to the dock and boat back to Feathermoon.
Grind yetis or Gordunni ogres until level 47 if you're short.
Fly Feathermoon -> Auberdine, boat to Menethil, fly to Ironforge. Train level 46 skills and fly on to Aerie Peak.
steps.warn: No Aerie Peak flight path yet? Fly to Refuge Pointe (Arathi) and ride north into the Hinterlands.
steps.tip: Stick to the roads through Arathi; Hinterlands mobs near the gate are 45+.

steps.text: From Refuge Pointe/Hillsbrad, cross Hinterlands' western gate and ride to Aerie Peak.
Aerie Peak: flight path, Hearthstone, and grab everything on the cliffs.
Check the Witherbark cages at Shadra'Alor / the Overlook (south-west troll camps).
steps.warn: Witherbark troll camps are dense and the Shadow Hunters hex.
steps.tip: Pull from range and clear casters first.

steps.text: Witherbark trolls drop necklaces - keep doing this across all troll camps.
Skulk Rock (central Hinterlands): Green Sludges and Jade Oozes.
Back to Aerie Peak.
Explore the top of the Altar of Zul (south-central).
steps.warn: Trolls on every tier of the altar.
steps.tip: Run the stairs straight up - you only need to reach the top.

steps.text: Jintha'Alor (south-east): free Sharpbeak's parents at the top.
steps.warn: [Elite pockets] Jintha'Alor is thick with Vilebranch trolls and patrolling bats.
steps.tip: Group up if possible; otherwise clear one tier at a time and rest between pulls.

steps.text: Grind owlbeasts / Witherbark trolls until level 49.
Fly to Ironforge and train level 48 skills, then take the tram to Stormwind and fly to Lakeshire for the Searing Gorge.
Gadgetzan: grab the Un'Goro quests before you go.
Short ride east to Steamwheedle Port.
Alchemist Pestlezugg / Tran'rek in Gadgetzan.
Ride west past Thistleshrub Valley and down the ramp into Un'Goro Crater.
Take it if an expedition member near the entrance offers it.
Loot the Threshadon carcass north of Torwa.
Stand by the raptor nests and wait for Lar'korwi Mates to come to you; loot the eggs.
steps.warn: Raptor mates spawn on top of you while you loot.
steps.tip: Loot one nest, fight, rest, then the next.

steps.text: Tar Beasts (Super Sticky) at the Lakkari Tar Pits; blue/green/red/yellow Un'Goro power crystals as you go.
Head north to Marshal's Refuge: flight path, Hearthstone.
If you found A Mangled Journal, turn it in to Williden Marshal.
Accept everything inside Marshal's Refuge.
Dinosaur Bones and Bloodpetals/Gorillas around the crater as you go.
Gorishi Hive (south): use the Scraping Vial on a hatchery wall.
steps.warn: Gorishi hive is dense - stingers and wasps chain-pull.
steps.tip: Hug one wall, and leave immediately once the sample is taken.

steps.text: Pterrordax and Frenzied Pterrordax fly all over the crater.
Find A-Me 01 by the gorilla terraces (north-east) and follow its chain back to Karna.
steps.warn: Escort: gorillas and Un'Goro Stompers ambush.
steps.tip: Keep your heal up; she's sturdy but the stompers hit hard.

steps.text: Spraggle Frock in Marshal's Refuge.
Ringo at Fire Plume Ridge: use Spraggle's Canteen whenever he passes out, then escort him to Spraggle Frock.
Un'Goro Gorillas / Thunderers / Stompers in the north-east.
steps.warn: Un'Goro Stompers stun and hit hard.
steps.tip: Pull Stompers alone and kite if you can.

steps.text: Keep collecting crystals and grind dinosaurs until 53.
Fly to Gadgetzan to hand in, then back.
Grind to 54 if you're short.
Fly Gadgetzan -> Theramore/Rut'theran (via Auberdine) and train level 52 skills in Darnassus. Then fly to Astranaar for Felwood.
From Astranaar ride east, then north up the road into Felwood to the Emerald Sanctuary.
Emerald Sanctuary: flight path (Alliance-usable).
Deadwood furbolgs just south: Deadwood Warriors, Pathfinders, Gardeners.
Jaedenar: Jaedenar Cultists, Adepts, Darkweavers.
steps.warn: Jaedenar Hounds drain mana and Darkweavers fear.
steps.tip: Clear from the road edge; casters first, and keep a fear break ready.

steps.text: Scout the satyr camp at the end of Jaedenar.
Jadefire Glen: Jadefire Satyrs, Felsworn and Rogues.
steps.warn: Jadefire Rogues stealth around the glen.
steps.tip: Pull from the hill edge and watch your back.

steps.text: Irontree Cavern (north): kill the cavern's furbolgs for 15 Blood Amber.
Ride north to Talonbranch Glade (flight path).
Nafien sits at the Timbermaw Hold tunnel entrance.
Deadwood Den Watchers, Avengers and Shamans at Felpaw Village.
steps.warn: Deadwood Shamans chain-heal the camp.
steps.tip: Kill shamans first and fight at the camp edge.

steps.text: Grind Deadwood furbolgs to 55 - every kill also builds Timbermaw reputation.
Walk through Timbermaw Hold's tunnel to Winterspring.
steps.warn: Timbermaw are hostile until you've earned enough reputation.
steps.tip: If they're red, hug the walls and keep moving.

steps.text: Ride to Donova Snowden at the hot springs.
Winterfall Pathfinders, Den Watchers, Totemics at the Winterfall Village west camp.
Winterfall Village (east): Shamans, Den Watchers, Ursas.
steps.warn: Winterfall Shamans heal and the village is crowded.
steps.tip: Fight on the edges; save Winterfall Firewater drops.

steps.text: Ride north-east to Everlook: flight path and Hearthstone.
Only if you carried it from Felwood or Darnassus.
Ice Thistle Yetis in the Owl Wing Thicket / Ice Thistle Hills.
Moontouched / Berserk Owlbeasts in the south.
Grind Winterfall furbolgs (great Timbermaw rep and Firewater) until 56.
Fly Everlook -> Rut'theran -> Auberdine, boat to Menethil, fly to Ironforge. Train 54/56 skills, then fly to Chillwind Camp (or Southshore and ride north).

steps.accept: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
steps.text: Herald notice in Ironforge/Stormwind - grab it on the way.
Chillwind Camp: flight path (if you didn't fly in) and Hearthstone.

steps.turnin: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!

steps.text: Skeletal Flayers and Slavering Ghouls along the road north of camp.
Kill Cauldron Lord Bilemaw at the Felstone Field cauldron, loot his key, fill the bottle.
steps.warn: The cauldron lord brings Bilemaw adds.
steps.tip: Clear the surrounding skeletons first.

steps.text: Use the key on the Scourge Cauldron itself.
Cauldron Lord Malvinious at Dalson's Tears. Check the barn for Mrs. Dalson's Diary while you're there.
steps.warn: The barn ghosts and Wandering Skeleton patrols add quickly.
steps.tip: Pull Malvinious away from the farmhouse.

steps.text: Use the key on the cauldron.
Cauldron Lord Razarch at the Writhing Haunt.
Use the key on the cauldron.
Andorhal: use the Beacon Torch at each of the four watchtowers.
steps.warn: Andorhal is full of Scourge casters and Skeletal Warders.
steps.tip: Light the towers in order around the edge; don't cross the middle.

steps.text: Cauldron Lord Soulwrath at Gahrron's Withering (east).
Use the key on the cauldron.
Diseased Wolves and Plague Lurkers in the middle of the zone.
Grind Scourge around Andorhal until 58 (Scourgestones are worth keeping for the Argent Dawn).
Fly to Ironforge and train level 58 skills, then fly back to Chillwind Camp.
Ride east from Chillwind Camp along the main road into the Eastern Plaguelands.
steps.warn: Level 58 is the minimum here - Plaguewood and Stratholme's surroundings are 60+.
steps.tip: Stick to the road and the south until you're stronger.

steps.text: Tirion Fordring's hut at Ruins of Eastwall (south-west).
Mereldar Cemetery: dig at the grave to summon Taelan's ghosts and kill Mercutio Filthgorger.
steps.warn: Digging spawns Mercutio plus several Scourge adds at once.
steps.tip: Clear the cemetery first; pop a cooldown when the wave lands.

steps.text: Ride east to Light's Hope Chapel: flight path and Hearthstone.
Ride south-west to Darrowshire.
Pamela Redpath sits in her house in Darrowshire.
Search the Darrowshire houses for the doll's head, left side and right side.
steps.warn: Each search may spawn a Darrowshire Poltergeist.
steps.tip: Search one house at a time with full health.

steps.text: Find Tirion's lost token in the Infectis Scar area.
Zaeldarr the Outcast in the Scarlet camp near Darrowshire.
Hameya's Plea: kill the named Scourge and recover the item east of Light's Hope.
Grind Scourge / Plaguebats around Corin's Crossing and Pestilent Scar until 59.
Hearth or fly to Ironforge and train level 58/60 skills.
Final push: grind in the Eastern Plaguelands (or run Stratholme/Scholomance quest turn-ins). Congratulations on 60!
steps.tip: Hand in Scourgestones at Light's Hope for Argent Dawn reputation on the way.

steps.text: Boat Theramore -> Menethil, fly to Thelsamar (Loch Modan) and ride south through the gate into the Badlands.
steps.warn: Badlands has no Alliance flight path, and Dustbelcher ogres guard the northern road.
steps.tip: Set your Hearthstone in Thelsamar before you leave.

steps.text: From Prospector Ironband in Loch Modan, if you have it.
Search the Stonevault troggs' area north-east for Agmond's remains.
Buzzards everywhere for wings; Dark Iron dwarves at Angor Fortress area for Ryedol's tools.
Dark Iron dwarves (Angor Fortress) drop Power Stones.
steps.warn: Angor Fortress dwarves are packed in groups of three.
steps.tip: Pull the outer dwarves; don't go inside the fortress.

steps.text: Lesser Rock Elementals west of Lotwil.
Find the mirage source east of Ryedol.
Uldaman: the tablet is inside the dungeon entrance area.
Grind to 40 - buzzards, coyotes and Dustbelcher ogres.
Mount stop: Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn - Randal Hunter (riding) and Katie Hunter (horses). Hearth to Thelsamar, fly Ironforge -> tram -> Stormwind and ride east.
steps.tip: Classic prices were about 90-100g with reputation discounts; check the trainer for Forever's price.

steps.text: Mount stop: Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh - Ultham Ironhorn (riding) and Veron Amberstill (rams). Fly to Ironforge and ride east.
steps.tip: Classic prices were about 90-100g with reputation discounts; check the trainer for Forever's price.

steps.text: Mount stop: Steelgrill's Depot in Dun Morogh - Binjy Featherwhistle (riding) and Milli Featherwhistle (mechanostriders).
steps.tip: Classic prices were about 90-100g with reputation discounts; check the trainer for Forever's price.

steps.text: Mount stop: Darnassus - Jartsam (riding) and Lelanai (frostsabers). Boat Menethil -> Auberdine -> Rut'theran.
steps.tip: Long trip: combine it with your next trainer visit, or buy a ram/horse here if your reputation allows.

steps.text: Mount stop: Skyborne riding trainer and mount vendor (check your capital; Forever's location is new).
Mounted? Ride back toward Stormwind and fly to Booty Bay for Stranglethorn.
Fly Booty Bay -> Darkshire, ride east through Deadwind Pass into the Swamp of Sorrows.
steps.warn: Deadwind Pass ogres and Swamp crocolisks are 40+.
steps.tip: Ride through the pass without stopping.

steps.text: Galen is caged in the Fallow Sanctuary (north of the lake).
Escort Galen out of the Marsh; open his strongbox at the end.
steps.warn: Escort: Marsh murlocs ambush in pairs.
steps.tip: Stay close and kill ambushers before they reach Galen.

steps.text: Galen's Strongbox.
Grind Marsh murlocs / Sawtooth crocolisks to 42, then head north through Redridge Pass.
Leave north through Redridge Pass into the Riverglades.
From Redridge Pass, head to Farholde Keep - the Alliance town on the island in the south-east. Take the flight path and set your Hearthstone.
steps.tip: Arriving from Lakeshire instead: go east through Redridge Pass south of the Bristle Hills.

steps.text: Farholde Keep hub: take every quest (Questie '!' marks) and work the southern settlements - Wheeler's Grange and Windstead.
steps.warn: Riverglades is contested: expect Horde from Rog'mar in the middle of the zone.
steps.tip: Hand in at Farholde between loops; the flight path saves the river crossings.

steps.text: Push north: Meadowsbrook, Elbrim's Farm and Turner's Logging Camp, then the ruins of Sunnyglade.
steps.warn: Sunnyglade and Twilight's Shroud are held by the Twilight's Hammer - caster packs and patrols.
steps.tip: Kill casters first and pull from the edges; don't fight in the middle of Sunnyglade.

steps.text: Optional dungeon: Krol'dok Stronghold (level 40-45) - pick up its quests at Farholde Keep. See /fxp dungeons.
Ride to Powderfuse Port on the east coast and take the boat to Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris.
Fly to Lakeshire (Redridge), ride north into the Burning Steppes and grab the Morgan's Vigil flight path, then ride west along the road to Blackrock Mountain and through to the Searing Gorge.
steps.warn: Burning Steppes mobs are 50-55; stay on the road at 48.
steps.tip: Take the Burning Steppes quests later - you'll be back at 51.

steps.text: Thorium Point (north-west Searing Gorge): flight path.
Wanted poster at Thorium Point.

accept: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

steps.text: Glassweb Spiders, Heavy War Golems and Magma Elementals around the gorge.
Dark Iron Geologists and Taskmasters at the Grimesilt Dig Site.

steps.complete: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
steps.text: Incendosaurs in the Slag Pit (south-east cavern).
steps.warn: The Slag Pit is crowded and has slaves who turn hostile.
steps.tip: Go in slowly and pull with range.

steps.text: Dark Iron Taskmasters and Slavers for the Kalaran chain.

turnin: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It

steps.text: Heavy War Golems and Magma Elementals.
Grind golems / elementals to 50.
Fly Thorium Point -> Ironforge and train level 50 skills.
Fly to Lakeshire, ride south through Redridge Pass and the Swamp of Sorrows, then south into the Blasted Lands to Nethergarde Keep. Get the flight path.
steps.warn: The Dark Portal area (south) is full of 55+ demons.
steps.tip: Stay in the north half of the zone.

steps.text: Bloodmage Drazial and Bloodmage Lynnore at Nethergarde Keep - five collection quests that each give great XP.
Snickerfang Hyenas, Redstone Basilisks, vultures, scorpoks and Ashmane Boars across the northern Blasted Lands.
steps.tip: Kill everything you pass - the drops for all five quests overlap.

steps.text: Keep farming the northern beasts to 51 - the collection quests can be repeated for more drops.
Fly Nethergarde -> Lakeshire -> Morgan's Vigil (or ride north from Redridge).
If you carried it from Tanaris - Yuka is at Flame Crest.
Firegut ogres at Dreadmaul Rock; Blackrock orcs all over the zone for FIFTY! YEP!
steps.warn: Firegut ogre camps have casters that heal.
steps.tip: Interrupt or kill the Firegut Ogre Mages first.

steps.text: Black Broodlings, Black Dragonspawn and Black Wyrmkin across the middle of the zone.
Gor'tesh at Blackrock Stronghold (west).
steps.warn: Gor'tesh is surrounded by Blackrock orc patrols.
steps.tip: Clear the approach and pull him to the outer wall.

steps.text: Grind dragonkin / Blackrock orcs to 53.
Fly to Stormwind, train 52 skills, then Menethil -> Theramore -> Gadgetzan for Un'Goro.
Mirage Raceway in the Shimmering Flats (south-east). Fly to Theramore, then ride down through Dustwallow into Thousand Needles, or swim from Tanaris.
Basilisks, tortoises, scorpids and rocket car parts across the Shimmering Flats.
Grind the flats to 32.
Nijel's Point (north): flight path and Hearthstone. Reach it on foot from Stonetalon or fly from Astranaar after one walk.
Smeed Scrabblescrew / Hornizz Brimbuzzle at Ethel Rethor.
Magram / Gelkis centaur camps.
Use the Kodo Kombobulator on Aged / Ancient / Dying Kodos in the Kodo Graveyard and lead them to Smeed.
Shen'dralas (WoW Forever) lies south through the Valley of Bones - see the Shen'dralas side guide.
Grind to 35.
From Desolace, go south through the Valley of Bones into Shen'dralas.
steps.tip: Level range isn't confirmed - published estimates run from 40 to 53. Leave if quests show red.

steps.text: Take the quests Questie shows (Evenshade Overlook, Outcast Hideaway, Magram Front).
steps.warn: Magram and Bristleback camps are packed; Shen'dralar areas may be elite.
steps.tip: Pull from camp edges.

steps.text: Finish the zone's story. Some chains continue into Maraudon and Razorfen Downs - see /fxp dungeons.
Talrendis Point (south-west Azshara): flight path. Ride east from Ashenvale's Forest Song.
steps.tip: WoW Forever expanded Azshara - Questie will show the new quests here too.

steps.text: Recover Kim'jael's equipment from the Blood Elves and Wardens at the camp nearby.
Quest the expanded zone with Questie and grind to 50.
Fly Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro) -> Cenarion Hold. Take the flight path and set your Hearthstone.
Dredge Strikers / Crushers and Stonelash scorpids near Cenarion Hold.
steps.warn: Twilight's Hammer camps and Qiraji patrols are 58+.
steps.tip: Keep to the northern half.

steps.text: Quest and grind to 58, then fly back to the Plaguelands.
Sten Stoutarm stands in front of Anvilmar.
Ragged Young Wolves for Tough Wolf Meat, just west of Anvilmar.
Balir only offers this once Dwarven Outfitters is handed in.
Rockjaw Troggs and Burly Rockjaw Troggs west of Anvilmar.
Your class trainer is inside Anvilmar - pick up your class letter quest if you were given one.
Train your first new skills inside Anvilmar.
Durnan Furcutter inside Anvilmar - a fast delivery if offered.
Talin Keeneye at the camp west of Anvilmar.
Small Crag Boars around Talin's camp.
Grelin Whitebeard camps south of Talin, by the troll cave.
Frostmane Troll Whelps outside and just inside the cave.
Grik'nir the Cold at the back of the troll cave.
steps.warn: Grik'nir is level 5 with a frost slow, and the cave fills up with whelps.
steps.tip: Clear the whelps on the way in and fight him at full health and mana.

steps.text: Mountaineer Thalos guards the tunnel east of Anvilmar.
Grind troggs or wolves to 6 if needed, then take the tunnel north-east.
Go through the tunnel and follow the road east to Kharanos. Set your Hearthstone at the Thunderbrew inn.
Buy Rhapsody Malt from the innkeeper for this one.
Class trainers are in and around the inn.
Steelgrill's Depot, east of Kharanos.
Pilot Bellowfiz and Pilot Stonegear at the depot.
Crag Boars (ribs and boar meat) and bears (thick fur) north of the road.
Wendigos in the Grizzled Den, south-west of Kharanos.
steps.warn: Wendigos pile up deeper in the den.
steps.tip: Stay near the entrance and pull them out one at a time.

steps.text: Explore Frostmane Hold (far west) and kill Frostmane Headhunters.
steps.warn: Frostmane Seers and Headhunters pack the cave.
steps.tip: Clear the outside first and only go in as far as the exploration credit.

steps.text: Rumbleshot's camp, south of the Grizzled Den.
Rejold Barleybrew by the lake, west of Kharanos.
Shimmerweed baskets / Frostmane Seers on Shimmer Ridge.
Ice Claw Bears, Elder Crag Boars and Snow Leopards west of Kharanos.
Leper Gnomes outside Gnomeregan's entrance for Gears and Cogs.
steps.warn: Leper gnomes come in small groups around the entrance.
steps.tip: Pull from the edge of the courtyard.

steps.text: Head east to Gol'Bolar Quarry.
Senator Mehr Stonehallow and Foreman Stonebrow at the quarry.
Rockjaw Bonesnappers and Skullthumpers in the quarry.
steps.warn: The quarry floor is crowded with troggs.
steps.tip: Work down from the ramp so you only pull one or two at a time.

steps.text: Grind troggs to 10 if you're short.
Train level 10 skills (warlocks/hunters: your level 10 pet quest starts here).
Grind to 11, or move on - Westfall catches you up.
Ironforge -> Deeprun Tram -> Stormwind, then run south through Elwynn to Westfall (Sentinel Hill).
steps.tip: Pick up the Stormwind flight path as you pass through.

steps.text: Young Nightsabers and Young Thistle Boars around Aldrassil.
Gilshalan is on the first ramp of Aldrassil.
Class trainers are up in Aldrassil.
Mangy Nightsabers and Thistle Boars north of Aldrassil; Grells and Grellkin drop Fel Moss.
Webwood Spiders outside Shadowthread Cave.
The egg is at the very back of Shadowthread Cave.
steps.warn: Shadowthread Cave is packed with spiders that respawn quickly.
steps.tip: Follow the left wall, grab the egg and walk straight back out.

steps.text: Top of Aldrassil.
Fill the Jade Phial at the moonwell north of Aldrassil.
Hyacinth Mushrooms (grells), Moonpetal Lilies (by the water) and Webwood Ichor (spiders).
Grind to 6 if needed, then take the ramp south-west toward Dolanaar.
Follow the road south-west to Dolanaar and set your Hearthstone.
Starbreeze moonwell, east of Dolanaar.
Starbreeze Village: the dreamcatcher is upstairs in one of the ruined houses.
steps.warn: Gnarlpine furbolgs fill the village.
steps.tip: Clear the house entrance before you go up.

steps.text: Nightsaber Pelts, Strigid Owl Feathers and Webwood Spider Silk as you travel.
Denalan, by Lake Al'Ameth.
Timberlings around the lake drop seeds; sprouts sit on the ground.
If not done yet, fill the phial at Starbreeze.
Ferocitas and Gnarlpine Mystics north-east of Dolanaar.
Ban'ethil moonwell, north-west.
Lord Melenas at the bottom of Fel Rock.
steps.warn: Fel Rock is crowded with Burning Blade cultists, and Lord Melenas shadow-bolts hard.
steps.tip: Clear the ramps slowly and rest before Melenas.

steps.text: Pools of Arlithrien moonwell, south-west.
Grind Gnarlpine furbolgs to 10 if needed.
Train level 10 skills (druids: start your bear form quest).
Grind to 11, or move on.
Run west to Darnassus, take the portal to Rut'theran Village and the boat to Auberdine (Darkshore).
Auberdine: flight path and Hearthstone.
Sea Creature Bones on the beach south of town; crabs along the shore.
Scout the furbolg camp south-east of Auberdine.
Use the Tharnariun's Hope trap on a Rabid Thistle Bear.
steps.warn: Rabid bears can give you a disease.
steps.tip: Trap one away from others and let the trap hold it.

steps.text: The red crystal is up on the hill east of town.
Fill the tube at the Auberdine moonwell.
Asterion's ruins chain: Grimclaw / Deth'ryll satyrs and Asterion's medallion.
Blackwood furbolgs, Moonstalkers and Rabid Thistle Bears south of town.
steps.warn: Blackwood furbolg camps have 3-4 mobs each.
steps.tip: Pull singles from the edge of the camp.

steps.text: Keep doing Darkshore's southern quests and grind to 14.
Den Mother in the cave north-east of Auberdine.
steps.warn: The Den Mother has cubs with her.
steps.tip: Pull her out of the cave and kill her before the cubs.

steps.text: Finish your open Darkshore quests and grind to 16 north of Auberdine.
Boat to Rut'theran, train in Darnassus, then boat back.
Boat Auberdine -> Menethil Harbor, fly to Ironforge, take the tram to Stormwind and ride east to Lakeshire (Redridge).
steps.warn: The Wetlands road and the Elwynn-Redridge border are far above your level.
steps.tip: Fly and take the tram - don't run through the Wetlands at 16.

steps.text: Zephras Isle: take every quest Questie shows (yellow '!') and follow the story hubs in order.
steps.tip: Accept and turn-in are still automated, so just walk to the markers.

steps.text: Finish the first hub's quests and reach level 4.
Visit your class trainer.
Keep following the main story and side quests to level 8.
Visit your class trainer.
Complete the island's story to level 12.
Train level 10-12 skills before you leave.
Leave Zephras Isle for your faction's capital (Alliance: Stormwind) and head to Westfall.
steps.tip: Westfall is a little low for 12, so take only quests that are still worth XP (grey ones are skipped automatically).

steps.text: Set your Hearthstone at Innkeeper Farley.
Most class trainers are in and around the Lion's Pride Inn.
Head south-west to Stonefield Farm. Kill boars on the way, you'll need their meat soon.
Maybell is inside the house.
Kill Stonefield and young boars between the farms for 4 Chunks of Boar Meat.
Gramma is inside the farmhouse.
Enter Fargodeep Mine (lower entrance). Explore it and kill kobolds for 10 Gold Dust and 8 Large Candles.
steps.warn: Kobold Geomancers cast fire spells and kobolds come in groups inside the mine.
steps.tip: Use the lower entrance, kill Geomancers first, and pull to corners so you only fight one or two.

steps.text: Kill Goldtooth for Bernice's Necklace.
steps.warn: Goldtooth is guarded by kobolds.
steps.tip: Clear the kobolds around him before pulling Goldtooth himself.

steps.text: Hearth (or run) to Goldshire.
Skip \"Shipment to Stormwind\".
Kill murlocs around Crystal Lake for 4 Crystal Kelp Fronds. WoW Forever: grab \"A Net Disaster\" / \"A Man About a Murloc\" here too if they're offered.
steps.warn: Murlocs run away at low health and bring friends.
steps.tip: Pull from the edge of the lake, finish runners fast, and stay out of the water.

steps.text: Run north-east to Jasperlode Mine and explore inside. Kill any kobolds in your way.
steps.warn: Jasperlode kobolds are level 9-11.
steps.tip: If you are under level 9, skip the deep parts; exploring the first chamber gives credit.

steps.text: Eastvale Logging Camp.
Guard Thomas is at the bridge west of Eastvale Logging Camp.
Follow the river north. The body is on the west bank where the river forks.
Rolf's corpse lies in the murloc camp north-east of the lake.
steps.warn: The murloc camp around Rolf's body is crowded and murlocs flee to bring friends.
steps.tip: Clear a path from the west edge, then click the corpse. Don't fight at the huts.

steps.text: Pick up 8 Bundles of Wood at the base of trees around Eastvale.
Kill Defias at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch for 6 Red Linen Bandanas.
steps.warn: Princess (level 9 boar) and her guards roam the pumpkin patch.
steps.tip: Pull Defias on the edges and keep away from Princess unless you have a friend.

steps.text: Back in Goldshire.
Run west along the road to Goldshire. Skip \"Cloth and Leather Armor\".
Westbrook Garrison, west of Goldshire.
Kill Riverpaw gnolls south of Westbrook for 8 Painted Gnoll Armbands.
steps.warn: Hogger (elite, level 11) patrols the gnoll camps here.
steps.tip: Watch your map for Hogger and stay away from him solo. Pull gnolls one at a time.

Get the The Crossroads flight path and set your Hearthstone in The Crossroads.

Loot A Talking Head from Rot Hide Brute and right-click it to start the quest.
Kill Moonrage Whitescalp.

Visit your class trainer for new skills. Take the zeppelin from the tower outside Undercity (Tirisfal) to Orgrimmar, then ride south-west into The Barrens.

Use Gaea Dirt Mound.

Collect Gerenzo's Mechanical Arm (from Gerenzo Wrenchwhistle).

Get the Splintertree Post flight path and set your Hearthstone in Splintertree Post.
Loot Befouled Water Globe from Tideress and right-click it to start the quest.
Collect Satyr Horns (from Xavian Rogue, Xavian Betrayer).
Kill Ashenvale Outrunner.

Collect Wrathtail Head (from Wrathtail Myrmidon, Wrathtail Razortail).

Visit your class trainer for new skills.
Zeppelin from Orgrimmar to Undercity, then fly or ride south through Silverpine to Tarren Mill. Get the Tarren Mill flight path and set your Hearthstone in Tarren Mill.
